//: Node 24 strips types from .ts on import with no flag, which is what lets
`node --test` run the pure modules directly with nothing compiled and no
jest, vitest or ts-node in the tree. That mode has two rules and they are
both set below: imports must carry their real extension (./layout.ts, not
./layout), and nothing may need a type to emit — so no enum, no namespace,
no parameter properties. erasableSyntaxOnly makes the compiler enforce the
second rather than leaving it to review.
